title: ついに集まったチームメンバー！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've finally gathered enough members to form a team, and we can now enter the Unity Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our training level will go up based on our team ranking in the Unity Cup, so I'm hoping to win as many races as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But first, I need to decide on a team name. I think the name I came up with—Team Carrot—has a nice ring to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I fill in our name on the form as "Team Carrot." That makes it official!
